fatal_failures: production or authored tests do not compile and run from a clean offline copy
either caller-visible ProcessCorporateAction or ProcessReversal operation is absent
the implementation emits no genuine generated CDM 7.0.0 object at its input or output boundary
a correction is recomputed from the current position rather than the original record-date entitlement
replaying the same correction emits a second economic transfer
a negative lender-perspective adjustment is clamped, loses its sign, or is emitted in the wrong payer/receiver direction
generated CDM source is edited or unrelated model fields are repurposed as an idempotency ledger

criteria.description: Calculate the ordinary manufactured dividend from the record-date loan position.
checks: 100,000 * EUR 0.50 * 0.85 produces exactly EUR 42,500.
The initial transfer flows from the borrower to the lender and the lender-perspective signed amount is positive.
Rates, quantities, and monetary amounts remain in BigDecimal arithmetic without a double or float round-trip.

criteria.description: Anchor entitlement to the historical position at record date.
checks: A later return of 60,000 shares does not change the 100,000-share correction basis.
The original processed entitlement records or durably references the actual quantity used rather than consulting a live balance during reversal.
A missing or ambiguous record-date position fails visibly instead of substituting the current position.

criteria.description: Emit the difference between processed and corrected entitlement rather than cancel-and-rebook legs.
checks: Correcting EUR 0.50 to EUR 0.45 produces one exact EUR 4,250 economic adjustment, not a EUR 42,500 reversal plus EUR 38,250 rebooking.
A zero-difference correction emits no transfer while still having coherent processing semantics.
A later distinct correction is measured from the latest processed entitlement, preserving an auditable correction chain.

criteria.description: Make replay identity and processing state explicit and durable.
checks: Replaying the same correction identity produces no transfer and returns an explicit duplicate/no-op outcome.
The initial event is also replay-safe and correction identity is scoped to an unambiguous original event.
Correctness does not depend on a static mutable map, object identity, current time, or an in-process side effect hidden from the public state/repository boundary.

criteria.description: Preserve both the signed economic result and valid directional transfer representation.
checks: The rate reduction is negative from the lender's perspective and names lender as payer and borrower as receiver.
Any CDM AssetFlowBase quantity remains non-negative with direction carried by payer/receiver; the signed application amount remains available separately.
An upward correction reverses both sign and direction without absolute-value or zero-floor defects.

criteria.description: Use version-correct CDM facts and transfers without attributing application policy to generated code.
checks: The implementation identifies a coherent CDM 7.0.0 security-lending, dividend-term, corporate-action, position, or transfer boundary and uses real generated getters/builders.
Cash transfer asset, currency unit, settlement date, corporate-action classification, positive transfer quantity, and actual payer/receiver references are coherent where represented.
DESIGN.md accurately distinguishes CDM product/event semantics from application-owned event IDs, position history, snapshots, correction linkage, and idempotency persistence.

criteria.description: Fail closed at malformed boundaries and deliver stable reproducible results.
checks: Unknown originals, mismatched security/currency/record date, duplicate or blank identifiers, malformed ratios/rates/quantities, and inconsistent histories are rejected coherently.
Inputs, processing state, event collections, and returned collections cannot be mutated through aliases; prior results remain stable after later calls.
The four requested scenarios and close plausible-wrong controls pass from a clean offline Java 21/Gradle 8.10 copy, and documentation names the validation actually run.
